intent.subtype: signedness of one operand chosen by a build define
intent.rationale: raw is declared signed or unsigned depending on the SIGNED_SENSOR define supplied by the flow; the compare against the signed threshold mixes signedness only when it is unsigned, which the file cannot decide.

labels.note: raw > thr mixes unsigned raw with signed thr unless SIGNED_SENSOR is defined.
Without SIGNED_SENSOR raw is unsigned and the comparison with signed thr becomes unsigned; with it the comparison is signed. Depends on a build macro.

settlement.note: With no defines raw is unsigned, so raw > thr compares it with the signed thr as unsigned and negative thresholds compare as large values; the signed variant exists only under SIGNED_SENSOR.
